Hi Samantha — thanks for the redline and the clear flags. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Quick answers up-front:
- Role stance: Redwood’s standard position is Processor for customer data flowing into hosted inference, but we acknowledge there are outputs (model-derived diagnostic signals) where joint determination can be reasonable. We will propose narrow language that limits joint-controller responsibilities to defined output categories and control points (see attached DPA proposal v2).
- Transfer addendum & KMS: Draft transfer addendum attached. We support customer-managed KMS for EU customer keys; happy to propose a KMS-integration schedule in the Order Form if Novamed wants keys retained under your tenancy.

Attached I’ve included: (1) a redline DPA that maps our runtime and hosting footprint to SCCs, (2) a bullet change-log for the MSA/Order Form items you flagged.

Open items we plan to cover on the call:
- Precise definition of "diagnostic outputs" (scope for joint-controller language)
- Subprocessor list and timing for EU-region nodes (Novamed asked for proactive disclosure)
- KMS options and operational runbook (who rotates keys, exports, etc.)
- Transfer addendum fallback: whether we accept Novamed’s proposed transfer addendum or sign our Annex and add Novamed’s protections as an exhibit.

Proposed next steps:
1) Legal-to-legal call tomorrow 09:00-10:00 BST (we can do 08:00-09:00 UTC) — Ben and Karthik on the call.
2) Following call: we’ll circulate an agreed-to redline and a sign-ready DPA + DocuSign link.

Would you prefer a call or a 30-min async walkthrough?

Thanks — I’ll hold time if you confirm.

Looping you all for prep notes before the call at 09:00 BST tomorrow. Their redline attached — highlights & recommended approach below.

Summary of external asks:
- Novamed believes certain model outputs may make us joint-controller; they want broader obligations (erasure, portability) for those outputs.
- They want proactive subprocessor disclosure for EU nodes and a transfer addendum with stronger fallback SCCs.
- They asked whether keys can be customer-managed.

Recommendations:
1) Controller/Processor: push for narrow, objective triggers for any joint-controller designation (e.g., outputs that include patient identifiers or where Novamed cannot reasonably deduce result without our model logs). Draft language in the attached DPA limits joint obligations to "Output Types A and B" and includes an operations-level SLA carve-out.
2) Subprocessor disclosure: offer a quarterly disclosure schedule and an initial enclosed list for all EU-region subprocessors; do not commit to per-change prior notice (we can offer prior notice for material changes).
3) KMS: offer both options. Default: Redwood-managed KMS with BYOK (bring-your-own-key) as a paid add-on and a technical runbook for onboarding.
4) Transfer addendum: accept a hybrid — Redwood Annex (our baseline) + a Novamed Exhibit that contains the additional commitments they need for Select EU exports.

Ben: if procurement pushes on liability, we should be ready with a pricing add-on for BYOK / dedicated EU pool. Laura/Karthik: please sanity-check the DPA redlines I added — especially the joint-controller carve.

Thanks — I’ll synthesize call notes and send a consolidated redline.

— Ava

Option A (baseline): Redwood Annex + quarterly subprocessor disclosure + Redwood-managed KMS. Limits Redwood’s joint-controller obligations to clearly enumerated "diagnostic outputs" (Outputs A/B) and contains an operations-level carve for erasure and portability.

Option B (customer-reqs): Novamed Exhibit (attached) that adds the extra commitments you requested (shorter notice for subprocessor changes, enhanced erasure runbook, and BYOK/KMS as default). Option B requires a modest order-form surcharge and a separate BYOK onboarding timeline.

Next actions:
- We attached: consolidated sign-ready MSA + Order Form redline, our DPA proposal (v2) with the joint-controller carve, and the Novamed Exhibit template.
- If you accept Option A, we can push a DocuSign envelope today and target signature within 24 hours.
- If you prefer Option B, please confirm and we’ll send an updated order-form with pricing and DocuSign link by EOD Monday.

Please confirm which option you prefer and whether you want the DocuSign for Option A today. If you prefer legal-to-legal follow-up, we can loop in external counsel and schedule a 30-min window Tuesday.
